text: This Lease shall automatically renew for successive twelve month terms unless Tenant gives written notice at least 90 days before the end of the term.
At the end of the term, this Lease converts to a month-to-month tenancy that either party may end with 30 days written notice.
Landlord may increase rent upon thirty days written notice at any time during the term.
Rent is fixed at $1,600 per month for the entire lease term.
Tenant shall pay a late fee of $150 plus $25 per day for any rent received after the 1st.
Rent received after the 5th of the month incurs a one-time late fee of $50.
A $400 administrative fee is due at signing and is non-refundable.
The security deposit will be returned within 21 days of move-out, less the cost of repairing damage beyond normal wear and tear.
Landlord will deduct the cost of professional carpet cleaning and full interior repainting from the deposit regardless of the condition of the unit.
Tenant is responsible for all repairs to the premises, including plumbing, heating, and appliances, regardless of cause.
Tenant shall replace light bulbs and smoke detector batteries. Landlord is responsible for all other repairs not caused by Tenant.
Landlord and its agents may enter the premises at any time, with or without notice to Tenant.
Landlord may enter with 24 hours written notice during reasonable hours, or without notice in an emergency.
If Tenant vacates early, Tenant forfeits the security deposit and owes an early termination fee equal to two months' rent.
Tenant may end the lease early with 60 days notice if Tenant is called to active military duty.
Tenant shall indemnify and hold Landlord harmless from all claims, including those arising from Landlord's own negligence.
Tenant waives the right to a jury trial and waives any statutory notice to quit prior to eviction.
In any dispute, Tenant shall pay Landlord's attorney fees and collection costs.
In any legal action, the prevailing party may recover reasonable attorney fees.
Tenant shall not sublet. Guests may not stay more than three nights in any thirty-day period without written consent.
Tenant pays electricity and gas plus a mandatory $65 monthly amenity and technology fee.
One cat is permitted with a refundable $300 pet deposit.
Tenant may peacefully enjoy the premises so long as Tenant complies with this Lease.
Landlord is not liable for any loss, injury, or damage to persons or property for any reason whatsoever.
No pets of any kind are permitted on the premises.
Tenant shall provide twelve post-dated cheques for the year at signing.
At the end of the term the Tenant must vacate the unit; the tenancy ends automatically.
Landlord may shut off heat or hot water if rent is more than five days late.
This Lease shall automatically renew for successive twelve-month terms unless either party gives written notice at least 60 days before the end of the term.
At the end of the term, the tenancy will continue month to month on the same terms unless ended in accordance with the Residential Tenancies Act.
The Landlord shall not, in any event whatsoever, be liable for any personal injury, loss or damage to property suffered by the Tenant or their guests.
The Tenant agrees to indemnify the Landlord against all claims, costs and damages arising from the Tenant's breach of the rules and regulations.
There shall be no abatement of rent for any loss of use of the unit before, during or after pest control treatment.
The Landlord shall have 14 days from the start of the tenancy to clean and repair the unit, and there shall be no reduction of rent during this time.
The Tenant shall be responsible for all legal costs on a solicitor and own client basis incurred by the Landlord as a result of the Tenant's breach.
The Tenant shall keep the unit in a reasonable state of cleanliness and is liable for damage caused by their wilful or negligent conduct.
